title: Campaign
description: content/campaigns/*.json. Mirrors packages/shared/src/types/chapter.ts Campaign; where the two disagree the TypeScript type wins. A campaign is a story arc of 4-8 chapters and the unit of the carryover commitment rule (spec §6, §8.2).

_note.description: Author-facing note that survives into the shipped JSON. Ignored by the loader.

chapters.description: Every chapter file in the campaign, including every member of a routed beat. Each must exist under content/chapters/. The set of distinct `index` values must run 1..n with no gaps, and a routed index must cover its route set exactly — checked by tools/content/validate.mjs.

routeSets.description: Named sets of story flags a routed beat chooses from, e.g. the three roads north, or the three pursuits. Declared here rather than inferred from the files that exist, because the failure worth catching is a *missing* member: only a declared set can notice an absence.

setbackLimit.description: Setbacks before the campaign fails — spec §8.3's 'fails at three setbacks, tunable per campaign'. Absent means 3.
